en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1494 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"No wind has ever blown except with a measure, except in the time of the people of ‘Aad, when it became rebellious against its keepers and emerged like the eye of a needle, destroying the people of ‘Aad. And no rain has ever fallen except with a measure, except in the time of Noah (as), when it became rebellious against its keepers and emerged like the eye of a needle, and Allah (swt) drowned the people of Noah with it."
